To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Elliot Reyes <elliot.reyes@gmail.com>, Talent Partner - Eli Moro <eli@recruiter-co.com>

Subject: Staggered interview day + quiet-room request and tech warm-up for Elliot Reyes

Hi all — final schedule attached and a couple of logistics/outstanding items. Please read the agenda (attached) and skim the 1-pager on the candidate (attached resume). Key points: 

- Candidate: Elliot Reyes (SWE 2) — morning availability confirmed.
- Schedule: three sessions (system design 45m -> pair program 45m -> team sync 30m). Start times are staggered to allow a 10-minute warm-up before each session.
- Quiet room / backup: We have a small reserved quiet room (Bldg 3 Room 204) if Elliot needs a private space on our side while onsite. If virtual only, see Zoom details below.
- Tech warm-up: ask candidate to join 10 minutes early for mic/camera check and a short connectivity check. We will have a host monitor the waiting room and admit them.
- Accessibility: Candidate requested extra time on the coding portion (+10m). Mina, please confirm whether the pair-program window can be extended; I've tentatively adjusted the calendar. Aditya, could you arrange captioning for the team sync?
- Attachments: Elliot_Reyes_Resume.pdf, panel-agenda-20270522.docx

Zoom (primary): https://redwood.zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=Pl4tForm  Passcode: 442179
Backup dial-in: +1 415 555 0132, Meeting ID: 123 456 7890

Please reply with any blockers by 11:30am PT. I'll ping the candidate 2 hours before start with the warm-up reminder.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Thanks Laura — looks good. I'll host the system-design session and can be the waiting-room monitor for the morning warm-up (I'll admit Elliot 10 mins early). A couple quick Qs: 

- For pair programming, do we want the candidate to use their own machine and share, or will we host an environment? I can spin up a container if we prefer a controlled workspace.
- If the coding window gets +10m for accommodation, I'd prefer to keep total day length reasonable. Suggest we shift the team sync to 35m instead of 30m (still fits).

I can also grab Bldg 3 Room 204 at 8:50am as a quiet room if they come onsite — will leave a note at the door.

Aditya: can you confirm captioning/cartoons? (typo intended) — sorry, captions. If you can arrange live captions or pull in CART, that would be ideal. If not available, set up auto captions on Zoom and add a quick note to the panel to speak clearly for the transcript.

Also, quick FYI to the panel: Elliot asked whether we provide a quiet space if they need to step away during the afternoon due to noise at their location. Jonas — appreciate you reserving Bldg 3 Room 204. I'll leave an emergency contact on the invite to the candidate (my cell below).
